title: One fixed tag list
description: tags/<facet>.json: every value a dossier may use for one facet. A new value is its own small pull request (see tags/README.md).

about.description: What this facet says about a dossier.

means.description: One sentence a stranger can use to decide if the tag fits.

retired.description: Set when the value stops being used. The value stays in the list.

use_instead.description: The value that replaced a retired one. The index groups both under it.
